steps.content:
You should buy from **Seller B - Brackmoor Sound** — for most people it's worth the extra cost.

Here's why, both listings are for the **exact same product:**

> Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones, graphite

Same specs in the box, same 40-hour battery with ANC on, Bluetooth 5.3, same 4.3/5 (210 reviews), same In Stock + Free standard shipping in 3 to 5 business days, same 1-year limited warranty.

The only 2 differences are price vs. returns:

**A - Ottervale Audio - $129.00**
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/v9z4pn/a
* Cheaper by $13
* Returns: 30-day returns. **Buyer pays return shipping.**

**B - Brackmoor Sound - $142.00**
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/v9z4pn/b
* $13 more expensive
* Returns: **Free 90-day returns.**

For headphones, returns matter a lot — comfort, fit, sound, and noise-cancelling are very personal and you can't know until you've tried them for a while.

With A, if you don't like them you only have 30 days, and you have to pay to ship them back. Return shipping for over-ears will easily cost you $10+, which wipes out the $13 you saved.

With B, you pay $13 upfront for 3x longer to decide — 90 days — and $0 to send them back if you don't love them.

**Bottom line:** Unless you are 100% sure you'll keep them and will never need a return, pay the $13 premium for Brackmoor Sound for the free 90-day return peace of mind.
